probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Lyngvær Menu Lyngvær Close Overview Buy Author Rooms Offers Restaurant Surroundings Events The house Plan your stay Booking Practical info Gift vouchers Contact Get in touch [email protected] +00 00 00 00 00 On the island now A family hotel on a granite island, with a sauna on the jetty and dinner from whatever came in on the boat. At the edge of the Norwegian Sea Five rooms, a keeper's cabin, a sauna on the jetty Book a stay Your host, third generation on the island Maren Hovde Velkommen. Maren Hovde Owner and host, third generation on the island My grandfather kept the lighthouse on the point. When the light was automated in 1974 the island emptied, and the house stood shut for thirty years. We opened it again so other people could have the quiet we grew up with. The story of the house Six rooms, none alike Five rooms in the house and the keeper's cabin on the point. Each one looks out on the water or the heather, never at another room.
